The player must navigate near the yellow bed (located at spawn-relative [9, 1, 10] inside the oak house) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the yellow bed'. max_distance=16 allows detection from the structure entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the bed rather than facing away.

scene_description: Three small houses made of different wood types are placed around the player spawn. Each house contains a bed of a different color: yellow (in the oak house at ~+9, ~+9), red (in the spruce house at ~-8, ~-8), and blue (in the birch house at ~-3, ~+10). The player must explore the area, check inside the structures, and identify which one contains the yellow bed. Additional scene elements include a cow, sheep, crafting table, and torch for visual interest.
task_text: Find the yellow bed. Explore the area and locate the yellow bed inside one of the structures.
design_notes: Three small houses arranged around spawn: Oak house (NE, ~+9,~+9) has yellow bed, Spruce house (SW, ~-8,~-8) has red bed, Birch house (NW-ish, ~-3,~+10) has blue bed. All houses have open front faces (full wall removed except corner pillars) so the agent can enter. The yellow bed is at relative coordinates ~9,~1,~9 (foot) and ~9,~1,~10 (head). Houses are within 15 blocks of spawn. Distractors (red/blue beds) require the agent to identify the correct color.
